lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，脚不落地有声。
lines.en: I move close to the ground, my steps near silent.
My tail hangs low and sweeps the leaves.

lines.zh: 湿地的水汽裹着我往前。
lines.en: The marsh damp carries me forward.
I slip between tree and tree.
The darker it gets, the steadier I walk.
I walk and listen at the same time.
The smell of something living is in the wood.
I curve along that scent.
I keep my footfalls low.
A damp trail drags behind me.

lines.zh: 我不走直路，免得被看见。
lines.en: I do not walk straight, so I stay unseen.
There is light ahead; I go around it.

lines.zh: 我的爪子几乎不发出声音。
lines.en: My paws hardly make a sound.

lines.zh: 这林子里没有第二条路。
lines.en: There is no second path in this wood.

lines.zh: 我沿着水气最重的地方走。
lines.en: I follow the heaviest damp in the air.
Nose to the ground, I sniff the whole way.
I stand, and my ears keep moving.
This tree hides me well.
I wait for full dark.

lines.zh: 林子里的虫忽然不叫了。
lines.en: The insects in the wood suddenly stop.
That is not because of me.
I begin a low hum.
The sound rolls out of my throat.
Even I find it unpleasant.
Water drips from a branch.
I lift my snout and sniff.
Something is coming this way.
I wait and scrape the bark.
I draw my claws into my pads.

lines.zh: 沼泽那边传来一声闷响。
lines.en: A dull sound comes from the marsh.
I did not go to it.

lines.zh: 我身上的水珠一格一格掉。
lines.en: The water drips off me bit by bit.
Did you hear that?
That was me.
Your eyes are searching for direction.
But they will not obey.
You cling to a tree and move slowly.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在找方向，可它们不听话了。
lines.en: Your eyes search for direction, but they will not obey.
You look back for me.

lines.zh: 我就在你左边，黑暗是我的猎场。
lines.en: I am at your left; darkness is my hunting ground.
You rub your eyes.
That will not help.
You hold your hand before your eyes.
You cannot see your own fingers, can you.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音很难听。
lines.en: I let out a call, an ugly sound.

lines.zh: 我的叫声，能让眼前发黑。
lines.en: My howl darkens your sight.
Half a step back, body low.
I curl tight and growl low.
I swallow the cry and back away.
The smell of blood excites me.
You hit hard.
My legs still hold me.
You should taste this too.
I stare in your direction.
The smell of meat.
You brought that?

lines.zh: 我的叫声，能让你瞎一阵。
lines.en: My howl blinds you for a while.
The smell of blood stops me.
Far too fresh.
Where did you get it?
I am not choosy.
Anything beats nothing.
Back off a little.

lines.zh: 我吃东西的时候不爱被看。
lines.en: I dislike being watched while eating.
I make no sound while I eat.
Do not bring your hand any closer.
This smell only makes me hungrier.
Why stand so close?

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有人分我的食。
lines.en: I do not like sharing my food.

lines.zh: 我的嚎叫，能让你看不见。
lines.en: My howl can blind you.
You walked into me.
Your eyes have not recovered.

lines.zh: 我退进树影里，只剩眼睛。
lines.en: I back into the trees; only my eyes remain.
Do not grab my coat.
I sidestepped that one.
The marsh path is slick.
You had better hold the trees.
You turn; I am no longer there.
You are still turning in place.
That is just right.
There is only me in this stretch.
You have heard my call.
That sound draws no mate.
I do not speak of such things.
You are asking the wrong thing.

lines.zh: 林子里的东西都躲着我。
lines.en: Everything in the wood avoids me.
You should too.
Ask something else.
Go on.
I will not see you off.
Something is on the ground.
I pick it up and sniff.
It is dead already.
That will do.
Did you drop it?
I will not give it back.
It is still a little warm.
I carry it behind a tree.
You saw nothing.
Right?
You are facing the right way.
A pity you cannot see.
I let out a long howl.
Your eyes are wide open.
It will not help you.

lines.zh: 我的叫声一响，你的眼前就黑。
lines.en: One howl from me and your sight goes.
You heard the sound.
I am the one making it.
Your steps have fallen apart.
I can smell the fear on you.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗里绕到你身后。
lines.en: In the dark I circle behind you.
You keep looking the wrong way.
I snapped a thin twig.
Now you know where I am.
Too late.
Every step of mine is light.

lines.zh: 湿地的水汽裹着我，往前。
lines.en: Wetland vapour wraps around me as I advance.
I hear it clearer than you do.
Your knee strikes a root.
I hear your pain.
My teeth flash before your eyes.
My claws pin your foot.
This one goes behind your knee.
You are dragged onto your knees.
My teeth are short, but they suffice.

lines.zh: 太黑了，你连自己都看不见。
lines.en: So dark you cannot even see yourself.
I bite and do not let go.
Tooth marks stay in your clothes.
I drag you down into the mud.

lines.zh: 你挣扎得越厉害，我越稳。
lines.en: The more you struggle, the steadier I am.

lines.zh: 天刚黑，我从林子里出来。
lines.en: The dark just fell and I come out of the wood.

lines.zh: 落在我身上的水还没干。
lines.en: The water on me has not dried.
This marsh smells promising.
I lift my head and call.
It carries a long way.
Every bird in the trees takes off.

lines.zh: 今天的猎物会自己送上门。
lines.en: Today the prey will come to me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝有光的地方走。
lines.en: I walk slowly toward the light.
That light will go out.
My coat is still wet.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，焦味冲鼻。
lines.en: Fire singes my coat; the smell is sharp.

lines.zh: 我从树上滑下来，摔进泥里。
lines.en: I slide off a branch into the mud.

lines.zh: 水漫过头顶，我往暗处游。
lines.en: Water closes over me; I swim for the dark.
Bark splinters dig into my hide.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的后腿。
lines.en: Something sharp sticks in my hind leg.

lines.zh: 那道光让我眼睛一阵刺痛。
lines.en: That light stings my eyes.
Hunger makes my call thin.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，毛全立起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and my coat rises.

lines.zh: 脚下的土没了，我掉进黑里。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I fall into the black.
